abilities.name: Soul Drain
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that roots one player for 10 seconds and drains health to him.

abilities.name: Veil of Shadow
abilities.line: is a short cast that cuts the healing one player receives by three quarters for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.line: is a short cast that heals him or an ally, so interrupt it.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.line: stuns one player for 4 seconds from up to 10 yards, and a magic dispel ends it.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.line: makes him immune to everything for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Howling Rage
abilities.line: is a 5-second cast that makes him and allies within 10 yards hit harder.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.line: hits its target and the player nearest that target.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.line: slows its target's movement by more than half for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Toxic Saliva
abilities.line: poisons its target for 2 minutes and drains mana, and a poison cure removes it.

abilities.name: Call Bleak Worg
abilities.line: is a short cast that brings a Bleak Worg for 4 minutes.

abilities.name: Call Slavering Worg
abilities.line: is a short cast that brings a Slavering Worg for 4 minutes.

abilities.name: Call Lupine Horror
abilities.line: is a short cast that brings a Lupine Horror for 4 minutes.

abilities.name: Void Bolt
abilities.line: is a 3-second cast that hits one player with shadow from any range.

abilities.name: Arugal's Curse
abilities.line: turns one player into a worgen under his control for 10 seconds, and a curse removal ends it.

abilities.name: Thundershock
abilities.line: stuns players within 5 yards for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.line: slows anyone who hits it in melee, and a magic dispel strips it.

enemies.name: Shadowfang Moonwalker

abilities.name: Anti-Magic Shield
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that makes it immune to magic for 10 seconds, so interrupt it.

enemies.why: Kill it before its shield goes up and wastes your casters' spells.

enemies.name: Shadowfang Wolfguard

abilities.name: Dark Restore
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that heals its worg, so interrupt it.

abilities.name: Summon Wolfguard Worg
abilities.line: brings a Wolfguard Worg to fight beside it.

enemies.why: Kill it before its worg, because it heals the worg.

enemies.name: Wolfguard Worg
enemies.plain: Shadowfang Wolfguards bring it, and it only bites in melee.

enemies.name: Shadowfang Darksoul

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Pain
abilities.line: burns one player with shadow for 18 seconds, and a magic dispel removes it.

abilities.name: Befuddlement
abilities.line: halves one player's casting speed for 15 seconds, and a magic dispel removes it.

enemies.why: Kill it first, because it halves your healer's casting speed.

enemies.name: Shadowfang Glutton

abilities.name: Blood Tap
abilities.line: drains its target's health and heals the Glutton for up to twice as much.

enemies.why: Focus it down, because it heals itself with every drain.

enemies.name: Shadowfang Ragetooth

abilities.name: Wild Rage
abilities.line: makes it hit harder for a minute.

enemies.why: Kill it soon, because its rage makes it hit you harder.

enemies.name: Son of Arugal

abilities.name: Arugal's Gift
abilities.line: is a short cast that curses one player for 5 minutes, and a curse removal ends it.

enemies.why: Kill it early, because each cast puts a heavy curse on another player.

abilities.name: Wavering Will
abilities.line: slows its target's attacks and casts for a minute and its movement too, and a magic dispel removes it.

enemies.name: Fel Steed

abilities.name: Fel Stomp
abilities.line: stuns players within 10 yards for 3 seconds and raises the physical damage they take.

enemies.why: Kill it before the Shadow Chargers, because its stomp stuns everyone in melee.

enemies.name: Vile Bat

abilities.name: Diving Sweep
abilities.line: hits its target and the players nearest that target.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.line: takes its target's weapon away for 6 seconds.

enemies.why: Kill it before the Blood Seekers, because it disarms you.

abilities.name: Expose Weakness
abilities.line: raises the physical damage its target takes for 5 seconds, and a magic dispel removes it.

enemies.name: Haunted Servitor

abilities.name: Haunting Spirits
abilities.line: is a 2-second cast that curses its target for 5 minutes, and ghosts come for that player.

enemies.why: Kill it early, because its curse keeps sending ghosts at one player.

enemies.name: Haunting Spirit
enemies.plain: A Haunted Servitor's curse calls it, and it only swings in melee.

enemies.name: Wailing Guardsman

abilities.name: Screams of the Past
abilities.line: silences players within 5 yards for 5 seconds, and a magic dispel ends it.

enemies.why: Kill it before it reaches a caster, because its scream silences everyone near it.

abilities.name: Forsaken Skills
abilities.line: is a short cast that curses its target for 5 minutes and lowers one skill again and again.

enemies.name: Gefell

abilities.name: Screams of the Past
abilities.line: silences players within 5 yards for 5 seconds, and a magic dispel ends it.

enemies.why: Its scream silences everyone near it, so it dies before it reaches a caster.

abilities.name: Summon Lupine Delusions
abilities.line: is a 1-second cast that calls two Lupine Delusions for 4 minutes.

enemies.name: Lupine Delusion
enemies.plain: A Lupine Horror calls two of them, and they only swing in melee.

enemies.name: Arugal's Voidwalker

abilities.name: Dark Offering
abilities.line: heals an ally within 10 yards.

enemies.why: Kill them one at a time, because each one heals the others.

enemies.name: Sorcerer Ashcrombe
enemies.plain: He waits in a cell near the entrance, and he opens the courtyard door for the Alliance.

enemies.name: Deathstalker Adamant
enemies.plain: He waits in a cell near the entrance, and he opens the courtyard door for the Horde.

skullNote: The skulls show the kill order in a pull. More skulls die first, and no skull dies last.
